headline: Executive order directs federal agencies to tighten oversight of the H-1B skilled worker visa program and coordinate more closely.
what_it_does: Based on its title, this order focuses on "program integrity" in the H-1B visa program, which usually means checking for fraud, misuse, or rule-breaking. It also calls for better coordination among the federal agencies that run the program. No summary was provided, so the specific rules, steps, or deadlines in the order are not known.

who_it_affects.group: Foreign workers on or applying for H-1B visas
who_it_affects.how: Their applications or visa status may face added review or checks from federal agencies.

who_it_affects.group: US employers that sponsor H-1B workers
who_it_affects.how: Companies that hire through the program may face added oversight of how they use it.

who_it_affects.group: Federal agencies that run the H-1B program
who_it_affects.how: Agencies such as those handling immigration and labor rules are directed to work together more closely.
